test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 01
subject: general
question: How many molecules of water are present in one molecule of copper sulphate?
solution:
__
 
• The number of water molecules in Copper Sulphate solution is **5.__**
 
• The chemical formula for Copper Sulphate in its hydrated form is CuSO₄. 5H₂O.
 
• Water is present in the form of crystals in Copper Sulphate.
 
• It is IUPAC name is Copper Sulphate Pentahydrate.
 
• Another name for Copper sulphate is **Blue Vitriol.**
